content.comment_body: Hello, When displaying text and parameters on the [product_name] operator device, I notice extra spaces that do not appear in the configuration software. For example, there are unexpected spaces between the number and the percent sign as shown in the attachment. Is there a way to remove these spaces? Apologies for the image quality! Thank you.
Which [product_name] module are you using? Please provide the complete [article_no] and the firmware [version_no].

My device is running firmware [version_no], but I cannot locate the hardware version. For my code: The following [product_name] models are compatible: [product_name] ([version_no]), [product_name] [version_no] & [version_no], [product_name] [version_no], [product_name] [version_no].
If your firmware version is [version_no], then you likely have a [product_name] model (please see attachment). Is your operator device an older version?

For reference, I also have an early [product_name] module and an early operator device. The display shows analog values in a similar fashion to what you described. This is a [company_name] issue. The values in the output field are presented left-aligned instead of being right-aligned; unfortunately, this cannot be adjusted.
My operator device is: [article_no] It's quite frustrating as it makes the display look untidy! Thanks for the support!
That's the same [article_no] as my operator device. It seems likely the issue is with the operator device itself.
Understood, that's unfortunate. Thanks once again.

analysis.insight_summary: Users reported that unnecessary spaces appear before the percent sign in parameter text shown on the [product_name] operator device, even though such spaces aren't present in the editing software. Multiple accounts confirmed this display and alignment issue, which appears to be a device limitation or firmware error rather than something users can fix through settings. As a result, the interface on the device looks less organized and may be confusing.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the text and parameters shown on the [product_name] operator device to match the formatting set in the configuration software, without extra spaces or misaligned elements.
